text: Run a Kimi K3 one-aim loop compatibility experiment
description: Configure a duplicated loop with provider OpenRouter, base URL https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, model moonshotai/kimi-k3, a clean worktree, and one atomic coding aim. Compare tool-call success, cycles, verification quality, diff quality, latency, and actual cost against the current provider. Do not start until an OpenRouter key and spending authorization are available.

status.comment: Requires an OpenRouter API key and authorization to incur model costs.
